svg.text: Shelf sensor node: breadboard wiring (Arduino Uno R3)
Full-size breadboard, rows 1–30. In each numbered row, holes a–e are connected to each other (and f–j to each other). Bottom rails: + is 5V, − is GND.
drawn with its USB socket on the right
Red jumper from hole a to the + rail:
Black jumper from hole a to the − rail:
Power the level sensor from 5V only:
its signal is as high as its supply,
Unplug the USB cable before changing wiring.
